name: blender
summary: [Blender](https://www.blender.org/) is a free and open-source 3D computer graphics software toolset used for creating animated films, visual effects, art, 3D printed models, motion graphics, interactive 3D applications, virtual reality, and computer games. **This image does not support GPU rendering out of the box only accelerated workspace experience**

version.run: curl -s https://projects.blender.org/api/v1/repos/blender/blender/tags | jq -r '.[] | select(.name | contains("-rc") | not) | .name' | sed 's|^v||g' | sort -rV | head -1

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

>[!NOTE]
>The arm64 version of this container ingests its version from the Ubuntu repositories, it is pinned at that version while the amd64 version will always be up to date.

changelog.text: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.
Rebase to Jammy, migrate to s6v3.
Use the full semver version in image tags. Arm32/64 version tags are inaccurate due to installing from ubuntu repo, which is usually behind.
